results.summary: This project displays a four-frame spinner animation on a 7-segment LED display while also demonstrating basic logic gates. It is divided into two subprojects: one shows the animation automatically, and the other lets users toggle DIP switches to see the effects of wire, NOT, AND, and OR gates. External hardware includes a 7-segment LED display and DIP switches. The design is created with Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes.

This project implements a multiplexer with differential outputs. The multiplexer inputs and select line are exposed on the input pins, while the differential outputs are on the output pins. The design is created with Wokwi and demonstrates basic multiplexer functionality. No external hardware or silicon results are described.

This project displays the name of the author's dog one character at a time on a 7-segment display. The design uses a counter to sequence through the characters. It is created with Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes. No external hardware or silicon results are described.

This project is a pseudo-random number generator intended for a Tiny Tapeout workshop submission. The design is created with Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes. The exact behavior and usage are not fully described in the documentation. No external hardware or silicon results are described.

This project is a simple XOR gate test design created for a Tiny Tapeout workshop. The documentation is entirely template text, so the exact implementation and usage are not described. The design is created with Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes. No external hardware or silicon results are described.

This project is a simple 6-bit shift register with toggle-enabled feedback, created for a Tiny Tapeout workshop. The design is created with Wokwi and is intended for educational purposes. The exact behavior and usage are not fully described in the documentation. No external hardware or silicon results are described.

This project is a 7-segment display controller with graphics capabilities, created with Wokwi. The design includes a shift register and counter to drive the display. It is intended for educational purposes. No external hardware or silicon results are described.

This project is a memory design with SRAM, 7-segment display, decoder, and multiplexer, created with Wokwi. It has three address bits, eight bidirectional data pins, and a read/write control, with outputs also driving a 7-segment display. To test, users connect address and data pins, set R/W high and clock to write, or set R/W low to read without clocking. The design is intended for educational purposes.

This project is a pseudo-random number generator with LED and 7-segment display outputs, created with Wokwi. The design includes graphics and counter elements. It is intended for educational purposes. No external hardware or silicon results are described.
